name: Zuriel
overview: Zuriel was a male member of the tribe of Levi, known specifically as the leader of the families of Merari. His role as a leader within this Levitical family highlights his significance in the organization and administration of the tribe's responsibilities. There are no additional notes recorded about him beyond his leadership position.
namesAndTitles: The name Zuriel means 'G-d [El] is [my] rock,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning that emphasizes God's strength and reliability. This proper name is noted in Numbers 3:35 and was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Zuriel is explicitly identified as the son of Abihail according to Numbers 3:35. Scripture does not record any other family relationships for him beyond this.
scriptureSignificance: Zuriel's importance in the biblical narrative centers on his leadership of the Merari families within the tribe of Levi. This position would have involved overseeing the duties assigned to his family group, contributing to the orderly service of the tabernacle. His mention in Numbers underscores the structured organization God established for the Levitical tribe's sacred responsibilities.
